name: Fruity Fizz #2
description:
A carbonated drink that continuously alters its flavor with each sip, offering an unpredictable taste journey through both familiar and imaginary fruits.

EFFECT: Provides a constantly changing fruit flavor experience, with no adverse effects noted.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Each sip of the beverage shifts the drinker's perception of the flavor to a different fruit, cycling through a variety of impossible, non-existent fruits known only in hypothetical or fictional contexts.
TASTE: Varies with each sip; starts with a common fruit flavor before transitioning to more bizarre, unidentified flavors.
PACKAGING: A vibrant can with a colorful fruit-themed design, reminiscent of popular soda brands. The label prominently features an amalgamation of various fruits with sparkling effects.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Perfect for those who think variety is the spice of life, or for confusing fruit aficionados.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-06-21 — edition #2 of the permanent record.
